pages.text:
Burns off excess gas so a refinery never stalls.
- Push any gas into it (through any face but the top): Refinery Gas, Hydrogen, Syngas, steam, anything a Pressurized Conduit carries. It burns up to 1,000 mB/t of it and gives nothing back.
- Its stack stands four blocks over its base, with a small pilot flame at the tip; the flame grows as it burns more.
- Only the base is a block: the stack is for show.
Put one on an overflow line (a conduit filter or a full tank's spill) rather than straight on a gas you want.
